parent_objective: design sequence-level command-response interventions over M740 v3 reset-only source rows

public_gates: M742 defines source adapter for M740 reset_only_rows
M742 defines source-balance and sentinel policy
M742 defines sequence intervention variants and horizons
M742 separates reset action outcome and wrong-history evidence
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat reset-only rows as wrong-history proof
do not inject hidden fault labels into actor observations
do not claim true single-wheel physics from current single-track proxies

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_sequence_outcome: test sequence-level interventions on v3 reset source surface
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs no-training sequence-level intervention over M740 reset-only rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no new data wave result and no checkpoint claim
stop_condition: stop if M740 reset rows cannot be source-balanced
stop if actor inputs or hidden fault labels are changed
stop if action and outcome claims are mixed
stop if training PPO or promotion is admitted
fallback_plan: if source balance fails, design v3 reset resampling or quota calibration
if sequence interventions remain outcome-sparse, audit before simulator fidelity branch
if outcome rows appear, audit before corpus export
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M741 promotes from v3 reset-only audit to sequence intervention design

hypothesis: Persistent sequence-level command-response interventions over M740 v3 reset-only rows will expose outcome-sensitive history dependence that cross-fault wrong-history swapping did not.
success_criteria: M742 defines source adapter and source balance rules
M742 defines sequence intervention variants and horizons
M742 defines sentinel action and outcome gates
M742 blocks source export actor update PPO and promotion
M742 admits only a no-training M743 implementation
failure_criteria: design treats reset-only rows as wrong-history proof
design admits PPO or checkpoint promotion
decision_rule: M742 may only design a no-training v3 reset-source sequence intervention. It must not admit source export objective design actor update PPO or promotion until M743 is run and audited.
